studies.title: The sweet orange
studies.caption: Sweet oranges combine a fragrant peel with juicy segments. Cultivated in southern China, they later travelled west through maritime trade.
studies.prompt: Botanical still-life of sweet orange Citrus sinensis fruiting twig, glossy pointed leaves, white five-petal blossom, two small ripe orange fruits; one cut fruit placed below with realistic radial juicy segments and central pith. Soft orchard background, no giant hybrid fruit or labels.
